requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The original requirement mixes a functional action (informing the security service) with a quality criterion (2s deadline). Per Pohl (2025) §25.2, this is decomposed into two separate structured artefacts: a functional requirement for the notification action and a quality requirement for the timing constraint.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service within 2 s after detecting damage.
structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service after detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from the original sentence, removing the specific time constraint to isolate the behavior.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service within 2 s after detecting damage.
structured_requirements.final_statement: The response time for informing the security service after detecting damage shall not exceed 2 seconds.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality criterion (2s deadline) as a separate quality requirement to ensure clear verification.
